title: How to Run OpenClaw on Mac (M1, M2, M3): Complete Setup Guide
summary: Run OpenClaw on Mac in 15 minutes. Step-by-step guide for Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3) and Intel Macs, including Homebrew install, launchd daemon, Telegram setup.
body_markdown: By default, the gateway binds to` 127.0.0.1` only. To allow connections from other devices on your network, update the` server.listenAddress` in` ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json` to` 0.0.0.0` . Then add an exception in macOS Firewall (System Settings → Network → Firewall) for the OpenClaw process. You don't need this for Telegram or Discord — those use outbound long-polling, not inbound connections.
